sql: SELECT cls, count(*) n_trips, sum(yt) sum_yt, sum(anglers) sum_ang, sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0) yt_per_ang, sum(case when yt>0 then 1 else 0 end)*1.0/count(*) frac_nonzero FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=2 GROUP BY cls ORDER BY yt_per_ang DESC
SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy>=33 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls HAVING sum(yt)>0 ORDER BY fish_date_doy
SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy FROM climate ORDER BY avail_t DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT ts_doy, avg(wtmp_c) avg_c FROM pier WHERE ts_season=2 AND ts_doy>=45 GROUP BY ts_doy ORDER BY ts_doy
SELECT cls, count(*) n, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang, sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0) yt_per_ang FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=1 AND fish_date_doy<=60 GROUP BY cls ORDER BY yt_per_ang DESC
SELECT fish_date_season, min(fish_date_doy) mn, max(fish_date_doy) mx, count(*) n FROM trips GROUP BY fish_date_season
SELECT report_date_doy, wt_all, yt_local, yt_all FROM fishdope WHERE report_date_season=2 ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC LIMIT 10
